summary: CrowdStrike filed an 8-K reporting fiscal Q1 2027 results and a Board-approved 4-for-1 stock split via dividend, payable July 1, 2026, to holders of record June 25, 2026, with split-adjusted trading starting July 2, 2026. This is a routine earnings release coupled with a non-event stock split that does not change shareholder value or corporate control. The filing contains no M&A, restructuring, or special-situation catalyst. Only a standard operational update and proportional share increase are disclosed, warranting no special-situations classification.
